tasks.title: Make toggle icon white in dark mode
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Add a CSS rule so the theme toggle icon appears white when dark mode is active. 2. READ FIRST: Read src/components/Calculator.css (contains .theme-toggle styling) and src/App.css (contains [data-theme='dark'] CSS variable overrides). 3. FILES: Modify src/components/Calculator.css only — no new files needed. 4. APPROACH: The toggle button uses emoji characters (🌙 / ☀️). Add the rule `[data-theme='dark'] .theme-toggle { filter: brightness(0) invert(1); }` after the existing .theme-toggle:focus block in Calculator.css. This converts the emoji to white via CSS filter. 5. PATTERNS: Follow the existing block-comment and selector style already in Calculator.css. No test changes needed for this purely visual CSS fix.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/Calculator.css contains a [data-theme='dark'] .theme-toggle selector with filter: brightness(0) invert(1)
TypeScript compiles without errors: npx tsc --noEmit exits code 0
